newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil barges down, fuel and gasoline steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil barges down, fuel and gasoline steady.

text.p: NWE oil products prices were mixed on Wednesday with gas oil weaker after Tuesday's benchmark futures fall, gasoline stable with few buyers, and fuel steady in active trade, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges saw the most activity with trade from $82 down to $77 a tonne though traders said the lower end of the range was the result of pricing against a Russian cargo.

Gas oil barge premiums were unchanged but outright prices were $3-4 a tonne easier after Tuesday's futures fall. Diesel barges were slightly better offered at around June IPE +$10 a tonne with bids coming from around +$9-$9.50 fob ARA.
Weaker crude and NYMEX unleaded futures kept gasoline buyers scarce but prices were generally stable. Traders pegged the market for Eurograde around $203.50/$205.50 per tonne fob ARA.
